030package dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate;
031
032/**
033 * The modification has propagated, in particular to the undo/redo stack.
034 */
035@SuppressWarnings("serial")
036public class ColumnChangeDoneEvent extends ColumnChangeEvent {
037  /**
038   * Create a modification done event.
039   *
040   * @param ev the event that started the modification
041   */
042  public ColumnChangeDoneEvent(ChangeEventData ev) {
043    super(ev);
044  }
045}
